newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eurotonnel to make statement on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Eurotonnel to make statement on Wednesday.

text.p: Channel Tunnel operator Eurotunnel SA/ Plc will make a statement on Wednesday morning, a spokeswoman said. She declined to give any details.
Eurotunnel and six negotiating banks reached an outline agreement on a restructuring of debt and unpaid interest of some 70 billion francs on Tuesday night, sources close to the talks said.

The company froze interest payments on its junior bank debt in September last year and has been trying to agree a refinancing which is expected to involve a swap of debt for equity and a convertible bond issue.
